headline: Oracle back online after crashing on missing files; CI workflows green; swap financing audit shows carry premise broken on half the book.
what_happened: Nine deleted files (reflect_cycle.py, execution modules, dashboards) were crashing nightly jobs since unknown date; restored from HEAD, test errors dropped 14→4.
Weekly CI workflows (data-snapshot, weekly-report) rebuilt and now green after 10+ weeks silent red; root cause was cron-disable only on sovereign-v2 while master kept firing legacy report.

Shadow_gapper Icarus signals dried up after 2026-07-27 (3 signal days in Jul, zero since); latest constitutional day return 0.0 on 2026-09-30.
Throughput bench: single-core 4,739/s, 12-core ceiling 12,571/s; legacy claim not beaten; numba inactive on py3.14.4 fallback.
what_it_means: The system was operationally dead (Oracle crashing nightly, writers DEAD) but is now restored. Workflows are auditable again. However, your carry trades are systematically mis-costed: the financing model underpays risk by 5–10×, and GBP_USD and AUD_USD have no paying side at this broker—half your book pays to hold, not gets paid. This invalidates backtests and needs immediate re-baselining (NN#4) before you scale into carry. Shadow gap signals have gone silent for over two months; that strategy is not generating.
todays_one_thing: Lock in the SWAP_RATES_ANNUAL correction (NN#4) and re-baseline every backtest result that depends on financing costs; do not trade carry until you verify the revised hurdle rate against live broker rates. Parallel: collect 9 more SWAP probe readings (target n=10) to validate the 2.03%/yr broker take and whether any pair has a paying side.
